$doc: Single source of truth for mintech/mintech_textures.py, kubejs/startup_scripts/mintech_items.js and kubejs/server_scripts/mintech_recipes.js. Keys starting with '$' are comments.

LAYOUT: this file is the index. It holds only the settings that every other file leans on (meta, vars, inheritance, defaults, global tags) plus 'include': the sibling files, each a config fragment keyed by the same top-level sections used here. Loading deep-merges them onto this file in listed order, so the result is one config identical in shape to the old single mintech.json -- nothing else in the pipeline knows the config was ever split.
materials.json   materials and their shared defaults (palettes, stats, crafting inputs)
parts.json       the craftable item parts (plate, rod, gear, hammer, bottle, ...)
ores.json        everything ore: the ore block parts, the veins materials carry, and the rock palettes/templates ore textures draw from
families.json    which materials get which parts
worldgen.json    the ore worldgen datapack: output paths and vein defaults
textures.json    the texture generator: output paths, tone ramps and shaders
palettes.json    named colour ramps for non-ore parts
templates.json   the ascii pixel art for non-ore parts

Files are grouped by subject, not by section: ores.json owns ore parts, ore veins AND ore textures, because those three only ever change together. Sections therefore span files -- 'parts' is split across parts.json and ores.json, 'textures.palettes' across palettes.json and ores.json -- and the deep merge stitches them back together.
meta.root is where every relative path in the config (output roots, template image sources) is anchored, resolved from this file's folder: '..' = the instance root, one level up from mintech/.

ITEMS = families x materials x parts. A family pairs material selectors with part ids, so metals get metal parts and fluids get bottles, never the cross product. Selectors: 'iron', '@metal' (group), '*'. family.exclude takes 'material:part' rules, e.g. '@gem:wire'.

INHERITANCE per item: defaults -> family.defaults -> parts[id] -> material.overrides['*'] -> material.overrides[part id]. 'inheritance' sets the merge mode per field (replace | merge | deep | concat).

INTERPOLATION: strings may contain {path|filter}. Context: meta, vars, family, material, part, parts (sibling item ids), self (this item id), texture, name. A string that is exactly one token yields the raw value (number/object). Filters: lower upper title tag path ns ingredient.

RECIPES (placeholder progression, replace freely): type shapeless (inputs), shaped (pattern + key), or smelting / blasting (input, xp, time); count; damage (ingredient whose durability is used, e.g. the hammer). A recipe whose {reference} cannot be resolved is skipped.
ITEM: builder methods called on the KubeJS item builder, {method: argument}.
